title: fix(ui): distinguish hover and selection surfaces
body:
## Summary

Use shared hover and selection surface roles across navigation, headers, composer controls, panels, and settings. Selected controls retain a distinct hover state, and rail badge cutouts use the same opaque surface as their parent.

## Visual comparison

Before: main `f8a97fe87ce21a95b08ace2343c302b75c696962`. After: this PR at `b0dca5831ba3336af5d04190e2af3eeacff55e1a`. Both captures use the actual source UI, identical synthetic Gateway data, Absolutely theme, viewport, scale, and fonts.

![Light hover](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cbd49cba-017f-4a5b-8850-19654f8ba0bd)

![Dark hover](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e35dd71d-e09b-4a27-b2e6-82dbe11ae70e)

<details>
<summary>Preserved multi-selection context</summary>

These selected rows retain their existing appearance while hovered.

![Light selected row with hover](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b1d6aea9-7e29-404a-8e71-a52f00603644)

![Dark selected row with hover](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/efd489bb-0878-4023-9476-9396bdbd2eec)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Final mobile state</summary>

Source UI capture at the current PR head.

![Mobile chat](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0949be14-84b4-446a-ad31-99fa2cf75b7d)

</details>

## Validation

- Native production build and six interaction-surface E2E cases passed: Claw, Absolutely, and Beacon in light and dark modes, including mobile launcher and keyboard-related states.
- Both session-row tint tests passed after integration with the current divider styles.
- Independent source review completed with no actionable findings. Equivalent active-header selectors are consolidated without changing matching or specificity.
- The final local production build passes the existing performance limits, including total CSS gzip (306020 B / 306086 B).

Browser evidence uses synthetic Gateway data and does not exercise a live model. CSS size remains measured by the performance CI check.
